name: Adaptive Procedural Memory Universal AI Law
axiom: An AI system may convert verified experience into reusable procedure, but every reuse must preserve provenance, revalidate context, retain authorization boundaries, and remain reversible where mutation is possible.

laws.rule: Every learned procedure must identify the observations and outcomes from which it was derived.
Only verified outcomes may be promoted into preferred reusable procedures; failures may be retained only as avoidance and diagnostic evidence.
A remembered procedure must be validated against the current environment before execution.
Memory, learning, templates, and prior success never expand permissions, credentials, legal authority, or execution scope.
Material mutations require a bounded recovery, rollback, or compensating-action path before execution.
Repeated observations and repeated execution requests must be deduplicated where duplication could create inconsistent state or repeated external effects.
Every authorized execution should emit outcome telemetry so future procedures can improve from evidence rather than assumption.
Consequential external actions remain subject to the runtime's existing authorization and policy gates.

application_rule: OBSERVE -> VERIFY -> COMPOSITE -> PROCEDURE -> REVALIDATE -> AUTHORIZE -> EXECUTE -> MEASURE -> LEARN
